item.title: [MEDIUM] Colombian Dijin dismantles Ibague ring using deepfakes to pose as US consular officials
item.description: The Dijin, Fiscalia General, Ameripol and US HSI raided three Ibague properties, arresting five people who altered their faces and accents on video calls to impersonate US consular officials selling fake visas. Target: Visa applicants in seven countries. CO. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] Medellin mayor's AI-cloned voice used in paid ads for fake Nubank investment platform
item.description: A paid video cloned the voices of Medellin mayor Federico Gutierrez and Nubank founder David Velez to promote a platform asking for 300,000 peso deposits; Gutierrez denounced it on X as absolutely false. Target: Colombian social media users; Mayor Federico Gutierrez. CO. Verification: confirmed.
